answer: When a sudden zephyr of cheap, fake AI accounts attempts to overwhelm a digital market, peer attestation graphs keep the network secure. In this system, a newly spawned entity cannot simply buy or claim credibility; incumbent agents must stake their own hard-won reputation to vouch for it across repeated interactions. Only through these gradual, high-stakes endorsements does an unverified node transform into a trusted pearl of the ecosystem, upholding an ivory standard of integrity.
